FROM dim_store 
WHERE store_name LIKE '%Pitäjänmäki%' 
  AND city = 'Helsinki'
  AND is_current = TRUE

calls.statement:
SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year 
FROM dim_date 
WHERE calendar_year = 2026
LIMIT 5

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar 
WHERE fiscal_period = 5 
  AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26', 'FY2026/27')

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  p.sku,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_product p ON f.product_key = p.product_key
WHERE f.store_key = 4
  AND f.sale_date >= '2026-08-31'
  AND f.sale_date <= '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY p.sku, p.product_name
ORDER BY units_sold DESC
LIMIT 3
